title: CBDT's Latest Update: Procedure for Form No. 98 Registration and Submission Notified!
content:
# CBDT's Latest Update: Procedure for Form No. 98 Registration and Submission Notified!

Ek important update hai. Government ne Reporting Person/Entity ke registration aur Form No. 98 submission ke liye naya procedure announce kiya hai.

*   Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Notification No. 3 of 2026, dated September 21, 2026, jaari kiya hai.
*   Yeh notification Income-tax Rules, 2026 ke Rule 160 ke तहत Reporting Person/Entity ke registration aur Form No. 98 jama karne ke liye naya procedure batata hai.
*   **Kon File Karega?** Jin specified reporting persons/entities ko Rule 159 mein bataye gaye transactions se related Form No. 97 mein declarations miley hain, unhe Form No. 98 submit karna hoga.
*   **Form No. 98 Submit Karne Ki Due Dates:**
    *   Agar declarations September 30 tak milte hain, toh Form No. 98 usi saal ke October 31 tak file karna hoga.
    *   Agar declarations March 31 tak milte hain, toh Form No. 98 agle financial year ke April 30 tak file karna hoga.
*   **Registration Process:** Reporting entities ko e-filing portal (https://eportal.incometax.gov.in) par apne income-tax return filing login ID ka use karke register karna hoga. Jo pehli baar register kar rahe hain, unhe "Pending Actions" tab ke under "Reporting Portal" link ke through details provide karni hongi.
*   **ITDREIN:** Successful registration ke baad, ek Income Tax Department Reporting Entity Identification Number (ITDREIN) generate hoga.
*   **Existing Form 61 Registrants ke liye:** Jo entities pehle se Form No. 61 ke liye registered hain, unhe naya registration karne ki zaroorat nahi hai; unka existing ITDREIN valid rahega.
*   **Effective Date:** Is notification mein bataye gaye procedures September 15, 2026 se effective hain. Lekin, Financial Year 2025-26 aur usse pehle ke saalon ki reporting Income-tax Act, 1961 ke तहत Form No. 61 mein hi continue rahegi.
